## Specification

### Component: Scroll area

Native overflow scrolling with slim overlay thumbs and edge fades that appear only where content continues. The browser does the scrolling; the thumbs are a draggable view of its position.

#### Anatomy
```
<ScrollArea>   <div class="ui-scroll-area" data-orientation data-scrollbar>      (position: relative; give it a height / max-height)
                 <div class="ui-scroll-area-viewport" role="region" aria-label tabindex="0">   (overflow auto, native bars hidden, masked)
                   <div class="ui-scroll-area-content">children</div>
                 <div class="ui-scroll-area-track" data-orientation="vertical" aria-hidden><div class="ui-scroll-area-thumb"/></div>
                 <div class="ui-scroll-area-track" data-orientation="horizontal" aria-hidden>…</div>
```
Only the tracks for the chosen orientation render.

#### Props
- `orientation`: `vertical` (default) · `horizontal` · `both`.
- `label`: region name (default "Scrollable content").
- `fade` (default true), `scrollbar`: `hover` (default) | `always`.
- `viewportClassName`, `viewportRef`; `className` styles the root.
- CSS knob: `--ui-scroll-fade-size` (1.5rem).

#### Behaviour
- A hook reads `scrollTop/Left`, `clientHeight/Width`, `scrollHeight/Width` and writes straight to the DOM (no re-render per scroll): thumb size `max(28px, track * client / scroll)` and `translate3d` offset `scroll / (scroll range) * (track - thumb)`.
- Root attributes: `data-overflow-x|y` (content overflows that axis), `data-fade-top|bottom|left|right` (content continues beyond that edge; only while overflowing, and only with `fade`), `data-scrolling` (set while scrolling and 900ms after), `data-dragging`.
- Metrics refresh on `scroll`, window resize, and `ResizeObserver` (viewport and its children) plus `MutationObserver` (child list).
- Thumb drag uses pointer capture: scroll = start scroll + pointer delta * (scroll range / (track - thumb)).
- Pressing the empty track pages 90% of the viewport toward the press (smooth).
- Tracks of an axis with no overflow are hidden (`data-hidden`); with both axes the vertical track leaves a .625rem corner.

#### Visual rules
- Viewport: `height: 100%`, `max-height: inherit`, native scrollbars hidden; radius inherited.
- Fades: a CSS mask (two gradients, intersected) on the viewport sized by registered `<length>` properties `--ui-sa-fade-t|b|l|r`, animated 220ms; mask applies only while overflowing.
- Track: 10px wide (2px padding), thumb 6px, `color-mix(foreground 26%, transparent)`, 40% on hover, 48% dragging. Tracks are visible on root hover (fine pointers), focus-visible, scrolling, dragging, or always.
- Focus ring: 2px inset outline in `--ui-ring` on `:focus-visible`.
- Horizontal: content wrapper is `width: max-content; min-width: 100%`.

#### Motion
- Track opacity and fade size animate with `--ui-duration` and `--ui-ease-out`. Reduced motion: no animation.

#### Accessibility
- Viewport is `role="region"`, `tabindex="0"`, `aria-label`: keyboard users Tab to it and scroll with arrows, Page Up/Down, Home/End, Space.
- Thumbs are `aria-hidden` and optional; native scrolling is always available.

#### Acceptance checks
- With overflowing content: the viewport scrolls natively, the thumb has a non-zero size, and moves when scrolled.
- At scroll position 0 there is no top fade; after scrolling there is.
- Content that fits has no track and no fade.
- Dragging the thumb changes `scrollTop`.
- No serious axe violations in light and dark.

### `ui/components/scroll-area/scroll-area.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useRef, type HTMLAttributes, type Ref } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useScrollArea } from './use-scroll-area';

export type ScrollAreaOrientation = 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both';

export interface ScrollAreaProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Which axes scroll. Default `vertical`. */
  orientation?: ScrollAreaOrientation;
  /**
   * Accessible name of the scrollable region. Keyboard users reach it with Tab and scroll it with the
   * arrow keys, so it needs a name. Default "Scrollable content".
   */
  label?: string;
  /** Fade the edges that have more content beyond them (only while the content overflows). Default `true`. */
  fade?: boolean;
  /** Show the thumbs `always`, or only while hovering, focusing or scrolling (`hover`). Default `hover`. */
  scrollbar?: 'hover' | 'always';
  /** Class for the scrolling viewport (the root takes `className`, e.g. a height). */
  viewportClassName?: string;
  /** Ref to the scrolling element, e.g. to call `scrollTo`. */
  viewportRef?: Ref<HTMLDivElement>;
}

/**
 * ScrollArea — native scrolling with slim overlay thumbs and edge fades.
 * The browser still does the scrolling (wheel, touch, trackpad, keyboard, find-in-page); the thumbs are
 * a draggable view of its position. Give the root a height (`h-80`) or a `max-h-*`.
 */
export const ScrollArea = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ScrollAreaProps>(function ScrollArea(
  {
    orientation = 'vertical',
    label = 'Scrollable content',
    fade = true,
    scrollbar = 'hover',
    viewportClassName,
    viewportRef: viewportRefProp,
    className,
    children,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const viewportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const setRoot = useComposedRefs(ref, rootRef);
  const setViewport = useComposedRefs(viewportRefProp, viewportRef);
  const area = useScrollArea({ rootRef, viewportRef, fade });
  const vertical = orientation !== 'horizontal';
  const horizontal = orientation !== 'vertical';

  return (
    <div
      ref={setRoot}
      className={cn('ui-scroll-area', className)}
      data-orientation={orientation}
      data-scrollbar={scrollbar}
      {...props}
    >
      <div
        ref={setViewport}
        role="region"
        aria-label={label}
        tabIndex={0}
        className={cn('ui-scroll-area-viewport', viewportClassName)}
      >
        <div className="ui-scroll-area-content">{children}</div>
      </div>
      {vertical && (
        <div
          ref={area.y.track}
          className="ui-scroll-area-track"
          data-orientation="vertical"
          aria-hidden="true"
          onPointerDown={area.onTrackPointerDown('y')}
        >
          <div
            ref={area.y.thumb}
            className="ui-scroll-area-thumb"
            onPointerDown={area.onThumbPointerDown('y')}
            onPointerMove={area.onThumbPointerMove}
            onPointerUp={area.endDrag}
            onPointerCancel={area.endDrag}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {horizontal && (
        <div
          ref={area.x.track}
          className="ui-scroll-area-track"
          data-orientation="horizontal"
          aria-hidden="true"
          onPointerDown={area.onTrackPointerDown('x')}
        >
          <div
            ref={area.x.thumb}
            className="ui-scroll-area-thumb"
            onPointerDown={area.onThumbPointerDown('x')}
            onPointerMove={area.onThumbPointerMove}
            onPointerUp={area.endDrag}
            onPointerCancel={area.endDrag}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/scroll-area/use-scroll-area.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, type PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent, type RefObject } from 'react';

type Axis = 'x' | 'y';

const MIN_THUMB = 28;
const SCROLLING_MS = 900;

interface AxisParts {
  track: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  thumb: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
}

/**
 * Drives a ScrollArea: reads the viewport's scroll metrics and writes the custom thumb size and
 * position, the overflow flags and the edge-fade flags straight to the DOM (no re-render per scroll).
 *
 * Root attributes it maintains:
 *   data-overflow-x / data-overflow-y   content overflows on that axis
 *   data-fade-top / -bottom / -left / -right   content continues beyond that edge (only with `fade`)
 *   data-scrolling                      set while scrolling and for a moment afterwards
 *   data-dragging                       a thumb is being dragged
 */
export function useScrollArea({
  rootRef,
  viewportRef,
  fade,
}: {
  rootRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  viewportRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  fade: boolean;
}) {
  const y: AxisParts = { track: useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), thumb: useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null) };
  const x: AxisParts = { track: useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), thumb: useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null) };
  const parts = useRef({ x, y });
  parts.current = { x, y };
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
  const drag = useRef<{ axis: Axis; id: number; startPointer: number; startScroll: number; ratio: number } | null>(null);

  const update = useCallback(() => {
    const root = rootRef.current;
    const vp = viewportRef.current;
    if (!root || !vp) return;
    for (const axis of ['y', 'x'] as const) {
      const { track, thumb } = parts.current[axis];
      const vertical = axis === 'y';
      const client = vertical ? vp.clientHeight : vp.clientWidth;
      const total = vertical ? vp.scrollHeight : vp.scrollWidth;
      const pos = vertical ? vp.scrollTop : vp.scrollLeft;
      const max = total - client;
      const overflow = max > 1;
      root.toggleAttribute(`data-overflow-${axis}`, overflow);
      const start = vertical ? 'data-fade-top' : 'data-fade-left';
      const end = vertical ? 'data-fade-bottom' : 'data-fade-right';
      root.toggleAttribute(start, fade && overflow && pos > 1);
      root.toggleAttribute(end, fade && overflow && pos < max - 1);
      const trackEl = track.current;
      const thumbEl = thumb.current;
      if (!trackEl || !thumbEl) continue;
      trackEl.toggleAttribute('data-hidden', !overflow);
      if (!overflow) continue;
      const trackSize = vertical ? trackEl.clientHeight : trackEl.clientWidth;
      const thumbSize = Math.min(trackSize, Math.max(MIN_THUMB, (trackSize * client) / total));
      const offset = max > 0 ? (Math.min(Math.max(pos, 0), max) / max) * (trackSize - thumbSize) : 0;
      if (vertical) {
        thumbEl.style.height = `${thumbSize}px`;
        thumbEl.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${offset}px, 0)`;
      } else {
        thumbEl.style.width = `${thumbSize}px`;
        thumbEl.style.transform = `translate3d(${offset}px, 0, 0)`;
      }
    }
  }, [rootRef, viewportRef, fade]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = rootRef.current;
    const vp = viewportRef.current;
    if (!root || !vp) return;
    update();
    const onScroll = () => {
      update();
      root.setAttribute('data-scrolling', '');
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => root.removeAttribute('data-scrolling'), SCROLLING_MS);
    };
    vp.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    let ro: ResizeObserver | undefined;
    let mo: MutationObserver | undefined;
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
      ro = new ResizeObserver(update);
      ro.observe(vp);
      const watchChildren = () => {
        ro?.disconnect();
        ro?.observe(vp);
        for (const child of Array.from(vp.children)) ro?.observe(child);
      };
      watchChildren();
      if (typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined') {
        mo = new MutationObserver(() => {
          watchChildren();
          update();
        });
        mo.observe(vp, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', update);
    // Fonts and images can change the content size after the first measurement
    const raf = requestAnimationFrame(update);
    return () => {
      vp.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', update);
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      ro?.disconnect();
      mo?.disconnect();
    };
  }, [rootRef, viewportRef, update]);

  const onThumbPointerDown = useCallback(
    (axis: Axis) => (e: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      const vp = viewportRef.current;
      const trackEl = parts.current[axis].track.current;
      const thumbEl = parts.current[axis].thumb.current;
      if (!vp || !trackEl || !thumbEl || e.button > 0) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      const vertical = axis === 'y';
      const trackSize = vertical ? trackEl.clientHeight : trackEl.clientWidth;
      const thumbSize = vertical ? thumbEl.offsetHeight : thumbEl.offsetWidth;
      const scrollRange = (vertical ? vp.scrollHeight - vp.clientHeight : vp.scrollWidth - vp.clientWidth) || 1;
      drag.current = {
        axis,
        id: e.pointerId,
        startPointer: vertical ? e.clientY : e.clientX,
        startScroll: vertical ? vp.scrollTop : vp.scrollLeft,
        // scroll pixels per pointer pixel
        ratio: scrollRange / Math.max(1, trackSize - thumbSize),
      };
      e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      rootRef.current?.setAttribute('data-dragging', '');
    },
    [rootRef, viewportRef],
  );

  const onThumbPointerMove = useCallback(
    (e: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      const d = drag.current;
      const vp = viewportRef.current;
      if (!d || !vp || d.id !== e.pointerId) return;
      const delta = (d.axis === 'y' ? e.clientY : e.clientX) - d.startPointer;
      if (d.axis === 'y') vp.scrollTop = d.startScroll + delta * d.ratio;
      else vp.scrollLeft = d.startScroll + delta * d.ratio;
    },
    [viewportRef],
  );

  const endDrag = useCallback(
    (e: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      if (drag.current?.id !== e.pointerId) return;
      drag.current = null;
      rootRef.current?.removeAttribute('data-dragging');
    },
    [rootRef],
  );

  /** Pressing the empty track pages toward the press. */
  const onTrackPointerDown = useCallback(
    (axis: Axis) => (e: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      const vp = viewportRef.current;
      const thumbEl = parts.current[axis].thumb.current;
      if (!vp || !thumbEl || e.target !== e.currentTarget || e.button > 0) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const rect = thumbEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      const before = axis === 'y' ? e.clientY < rect.top : e.clientX < rect.left;
      const page = (axis === 'y' ? vp.clientHeight : vp.clientWidth) * 0.9;
      const by = before ? -page : page;
      vp.scrollBy(axis === 'y' ? { top: by, behavior: 'smooth' } : { left: by, behavior: 'smooth' });
    },
    [viewportRef],
  );

  return { y, x, onThumbPointerDown, onThumbPointerMove, endDrag, onTrackPointerDown };
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/scroll-area.css`

```css
/* Scroll area -------------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-scroll-area[data-orientation="vertical|horizontal|both"][data-scrollbar="hover|always"]
     > .ui-scroll-area-viewport (native overflow, role=region, tabindex=0) > .ui-scroll-area-content
     > .ui-scroll-area-track[data-orientation] > .ui-scroll-area-thumb
   The JS hook writes on the root: data-overflow-x|y, data-fade-top|bottom|left|right,
   data-scrolling, data-dragging. Fades are a mask on the viewport, sized by the
   --ui-sa-fade-* properties (animated), so they only show where content continues.
   Size it from outside: height or max-height on the root.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@property --ui-sa-fade-t { syntax: "<length>"; inherits: true; initial-value: 0px; }
@property --ui-sa-fade-b { syntax: "<length>"; inherits: true; initial-value: 0px; }
@property --ui-sa-fade-l { syntax: "<length>"; inherits: true; initial-value: 0px; }
@property --ui-sa-fade-r { syntax: "<length>"; inherits: true; initial-value: 0px; }

@layer components {
  .ui-scroll-area {
    position: relative;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    transition:
      --ui-sa-fade-t var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out),
      --ui-sa-fade-b var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out),
      --ui-sa-fade-l var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out),
      --ui-sa-fade-r var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out);
  }
  .ui-scroll-area[data-fade-top] { --ui-sa-fade-t: var(--ui-scroll-fade-size, 1.5rem); }
  .ui-scroll-area[data-fade-bottom] { --ui-sa-fade-b: var(--ui-scroll-fade-size, 1.5rem); }
  .ui-scroll-area[data-fade-left] { --ui-sa-fade-l: var(--ui-scroll-fade-size, 1.5rem); }
  .ui-scroll-area[data-fade-right] { --ui-sa-fade-r: var(--ui-scroll-fade-size, 1.5rem); }

  .ui-scroll-area-viewport {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    max-height: inherit;
    overflow: auto;
    border-radius: inherit;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-scroll-area-viewport::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .ui-scroll-area-viewport:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 70%, transparent);
    outline-offset: -2px;
  }
  .ui-scroll-area[data-orientation="vertical"] > .ui-scroll-area-viewport { overflow-x: hidden; }
  .ui-scroll-area[data-orientation="horizontal"] > .ui-scroll-area-viewport { overflow-y: hidden; }
  .ui-scroll-area[data-orientation="horizontal"] > .ui-scroll-area-viewport > .ui-scroll-area-content {
    width: max-content;
    min-width: 100%;
  }
  .ui-scroll-area-content { min-width: 0; }

  /* Edge fades: masked only while something overflows */
  .ui-scroll-area[data-overflow-x] > .ui-scroll-area-viewport,
  .ui-scroll-area[data-overflow-y] > .ui-scroll-area-viewport {
    -webkit-mask-image:
      linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, black var(--ui-sa-fade-t), black calc(100% - var(--ui-sa-fade-b)), transparent 100%),
      linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0, black var(--ui-sa-fade-l), black calc(100% - var(--ui-sa-fade-r)), transparent 100%);
    mask-image:
      linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, black var(--ui-sa-fade-t), black calc(100% - var(--ui-sa-fade-b)), transparent 100%),
      linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0, black var(--ui-sa-fade-l), black calc(100% - var(--ui-sa-fade-r)), transparent 100%);
    -webkit-mask-composite: source-in;
    mask-composite: intersect;
  }

  /* Overlay thumbs */
  .ui-scroll-area-track {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 1;
    display: flex;
    padding: 2px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    opacity: 0;
    touch-action: none;
    user-select: none;
    transition: opacity var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out);
  }
  .ui-scroll-area-track[data-hidden] { display: none; }
  .ui-scroll-area-track[data-orientation="vertical"] { top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 0.625rem; flex-direction: column; }
  .ui-scroll-area-track[data-orientation="horizontal"] { left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 0.625rem; flex-direction: row; }
  .ui-scroll-area[data-overflow-x] > .ui-scroll-area-track[data-orientation="vertical"] { bottom: 0.625rem; }
  .ui-scroll-area[data-overflow-y] > .ui-scroll-area-track[data-orientation="horizontal"] { right: 0.625rem; }

  .ui-scroll-area-thumb {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 26%, transparent);
    cursor: default;
    will-change: transform;
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-scroll-area-track[data-orientation="vertical"] > .ui-scroll-area-thumb { width: 100%; }
  .ui-scroll-area-track[data-orientation="horizontal"] > .ui-scroll-area-thumb { height: 100%; }

  .ui-scroll-area[data-scrolling] > .ui-scroll-area-track,
  .ui-scroll-area[data-dragging] > .ui-scroll-area-track,
  .ui-scroll-area[data-scrollbar="always"] > .ui-scroll-area-track,
  .ui-scroll-area-viewport:focus-visible ~ .ui-scroll-area-track { opacity: 1; }
  .ui-scroll-area[data-dragging] { user-select: none; }
  .ui-scroll-area[data-dragging] .ui-scroll-area-thumb { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 48%, transparent); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-scroll-area:hover > .ui-scroll-area-track { opacity: 1; }
    .ui-scroll-area-thumb:hover { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 40%, transparent); }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Changelog** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/scroll-area/changelog.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/ui/components/scroll-area';

const releases = [
  { version: '2.14.0', date: '24 November 2026', tag: 'Feature', notes: ['Scheduled reports can be sent to Slack channels.', 'Invoices show a payment timeline.', 'New keyboard shortcut ⌘K for the command menu.'] },
  { version: '2.13.2', date: '12 November 2026', tag: 'Fix', notes: ['Fixed rounding on multi-currency invoices.', 'CSV exports keep leading zeros in account numbers.'] },
  { version: '2.13.0', date: '29 October 2026', tag: 'Feature', notes: ['Team roles: viewer, editor, billing admin.', 'Audit log retention extended to 24 months.', 'Dark mode follows the system setting by default.'] },
  { version: '2.12.1', date: '16 October 2026', tag: 'Fix', notes: ['Webhook retries no longer duplicate events.', 'Date pickers respect the workspace week start.'] },
  { version: '2.12.0', date: '2 October 2026', tag: 'Feature', notes: ['Import customers from a CSV in under a minute.', 'Bulk actions on the invoice list.', 'Faster dashboard loads for workspaces over 10,000 rows.'] },
  { version: '2.11.0', date: '18 September 2026', tag: 'Feature', notes: ['Expense categories can be nested.', 'Receipts are scanned and matched automatically.'] },
];

export default function ScrollAreaChangelog() {
  return (
    <ScrollArea className="h-80 w-full max-w-lg rounded-lg border border-border" label="Changelog" viewportClassName="px-5 py-4">
      <h3 className="mb-4 text-md font-semibold tracking-tight">Changelog</h3>
      <ol className="space-y-6">
        {releases.map((r) => (
          <li key={r.version}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-base font-medium tabular-nums">v{r.version}</span>
              <Badge variant={r.tag === 'Fix' ? 'secondary' : 'success'} size="sm">
                {r.tag}
              </Badge>
              <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.date}</span>
            </div>
            <ul className="mt-2 list-disc space-y-1 pl-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {r.notes.map((n) => (
                <li key={n}>{n}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </ScrollArea>
  );
}
```
